title: Knowledge Base Query Log
description: Audit trail of knowledge base queries made during a pipeline phase. Records what was queried, what results were returned, and how they influenced decisions. Not a pipeline artifact per se, but saved alongside run artifacts for traceability.

phase.description: Phase during which these queries were made

debate_transcript_id.description: If queries were made during a debate, the transcript ID

source.description: Name of the knowledge base source queried

query.description: The search string (vector) or template name (SQL)

results_used.description: IDs or references of results that were actually used in decision-making

influence.description: How this query's results influenced the phase output
